svg.title: How foresight chooses a model
svg.desc: 1: at each of the last origins every candidate is fitted on the data before it and forecasts 1 to h periods ahead. 2: the errors are measured by horizon. 3: the candidates, and the average of the best, are ranked by their error and the best is chosen. 4: the intervals are quantiles of the relative errors, by horizon and for totals.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every candidate is refitted at every origin with the data before it, and judged on what came next.

svg.text: No information criterion decides, and no distribution is assumed: both the choice and the intervals come from forecasts made without seeing the answer.
